Coldplay’s “Viva la Vida” is a retelling of the French Revolution | by Jaebin Yoo | Medium
s: August 24, 2018 - Coldplay’s fourth studio album, “Viva la Vida or Death to All His Friends” often simple referred to as “Viva la Vida”, features a rendition of the 1830 historical painting known as “Liberty Leading the People”. The art piece was painted by French artist Eugène Delacroix, depicting French revolutionaries marching and waving the French flag, led by the human manifestation of Lady Liberty.
